findings.title: DB125 terminals: 1.30 mm finished holes vs maker 1.20 mm; process/S-8 allocation open (insertion hypothesis narrowed)

evidence.native: all 23 pads circle 1.90 mm copper, drill 1.30 mm, pitch 3.50 mm; annular ring 0.30 mm nominal, 0.235 mm at JLC maximum finished hole 1.43 mm (JLC minimum ring 0.20 mm)
evidence.maker: DORABO DB125-3.5-XXP-C-S drawing T0-1 p1 (https://atta.szlcsc.com/upload/public/pdf/source/20251124/8C215F69B14C8E54AE0F8E5023D4AE9F.pdf): Pin Dimensions 0.50x0.85 mm, PCB Hole Diameter 1.20 mm, 28-16 AWG, pin row 3.90 mm from rear face / 3.50 mm from wire-entry face
evidence.clearance: nominal pin diagonal 0.986 mm; minimum finished hole 1.30-0.08 = 1.22 mm (https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: PTH +0.13/-0.08) leaves 0.234 mm diametral clearance (0.165 mm even for a 0.55x0.90 pin). The carried 0.70x1.05 mm (1.262 mm) corner applies the +/-0.20 general linear tolerance to the stamped pin section; such a pin could not enter the maker's own 1.20 mm hole, so it is not a credible insertion failure.
evidence.orientation: Fresh EasyEDA records (C466970, C52993880, C2757925, C3646874) all put wire-entry openings and insertion arrows on local +y (y +1.4..+3.9 mm), the same side as ours (wire entry +y); CPL theta 0 needs no BODY correction. T0-1 is third-angle (top view above front view, symbol circles-left): the edge adjacent to the front view is the entry face, 3.50 mm from the pins, matching our Fab body (-3.9..+3.5). EasyEDA 5P outline is mirrored in depth (-3.5..+3.9): library-only, no placement effect, but do not use it for bore fit.
evidence.S8: J121.1 nominal hole-wall to In2 3V3 1.102502 mm (R10_VALIDATION deviations section 1/9); fabricated diameter/registration allocation still not certified

findings.impact: No demonstrated insertion or isolation failure. Residual risks are fabrication allocation at the pyro barrel (S-8 margin 0.1025 mm nominal), selective/hand-solder barrel fill and first-article seating.
findings.concrete_fix: No CAD change (do not shrink or enlarge the drill). Record the T0-1 pin/hole data above to close the conditional-insertion sub-item; keep the fabricator finished-hole/registration S-8 allocation for J121 and first-article seating/fill inspection of all 23 contacts; confirm outward entry in the JLC preview.

findings.title: L400 SRP5030T-6R8M uses a proxy land, not Bourns' recommended layout

evidence.ref: L400 C1329837, F(24.2,5.55) rot 0, F.Cu, nets PORT_SW/PORT_5V3
evidence.native: pads 1.8 x 2.5 mm at x = +/-2.35 (outer 6.50, inner gap 2.90 mm)
evidence.maker: Bourns SRP5030T p1 Recommended Layout (https://www.bourns.com/docs/product-datasheets/srp5030t.pdf): 6.50 outer, 2.50 inner gap, 1.8 pad height -> 2.0 x 1.8 mm at +/-2.25; body 5.7+/-0.3 x 5.2+/-0.2, terminal 1.1+/-0.3
evidence.jlc: EasyEDA proxy C189932 (same SRP5030T package) residual 0.150 mm; live stock 1,541

findings.impact: Worst-case terminal heel can sit about 0.15 mm inside the pad inner edge (x 1.30 vs 1.45); bounded wetting/retention risk on the port buck inductor, no electrical failure shown.
findings.concrete_fix: If the board is changed for any other reason, generate L400 as 2.0 x 1.8 mm pads at +/-2.25 mm (Bourns) and re-route PORT_SW/PORT_5V3 entries; otherwise keep first-article heel-wetting inspection (X-ray/side view) as recorded.

findings.title: VCAP C19/C20 X5R +/-10% parts have no maker-bounded worst-case capacitance against ST +/-20%

evidence.maker: ST DS12110 Rev 8 section 6.3.2 Table 25 (p109) and section 7.3.2 Table 124 (p215), cached; current Rev 11 Table 114 p211 per R17 (https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stm32h743vi.pdf): CEXT 2.2 uF typical, +/-20% tolerated, ESR < 100 mOhm. Samsung sheet: https://product.samsungsem.com/part/download.do?masterKey=CL10A225KO8NNN&type=specsheet
evidence.estimate: Inference with generic X5R allowances (not maker curves): 2.2 x 0.90 (tol) x 0.85 (85 C) x 0.95 (bias at ~1.2 V) x 0.95 (aging) = 1.52 uF, below 1.76 uF; nominal 1.98..2.42 uF is inside the range.

findings.impact: Possible LDO stability margin loss at hot/aged corners; not demonstrated.
findings.concrete_fix: Keep the bench qualification in ORDERING (both C limits, ESR, startup/load transients at temperature), or adopt a reviewed X7R 2.2 uF 0603 (>=10 V) with maker curves bounding >=1.76 uF; no larger-value substitution.
